_note: Ready-to-use defaults. The ids below are Easy Code's public catalog, and the same four OpenAI models back every other host here. Copy this to config/host.local.json (git-ignored) when your machine differs — e.g. a different catalog or extra profiles. `active` picks the entry G0 reads.

easycode._note: Switch models in the host UI; there is no switching API, so a stage change is a manual switch or a new session.

invocation.design: 在本宿主 UI 里切到 models.design[gear]
invocation.review: 新开会话 + 切到 models.review[gear]

estimate._note: relative comparison only, not a budget

codex._note: One config layer per role, selected with --profile. See docs/HOSTS.md for the [agents] table.

claude-code._note: Skill dir is ~/.claude/skills. Fill in the aliases or full ids your plan exposes.

frontmatter.description: 只读 diff 与 spec，逐条 AC 找反例

opencode._note: Reads .opencode/skills plus compat .agents/skills. Roles map onto built-ins plan/build + a reviewer subagent.

invocation.design: opencode 里用 plan agent（配 design 模型）
invocation.code: opencode 里用 build agent（配 cheap 模型）
invocation.review: 起 reviewer 子代理（只读权限）

cursor._note: Reads .agents/skills natively. Model can change mid-conversation; G4 opens a new chat.

invocation.design: 模型选择器选 design 模型
invocation.review: 新开对话 + 选 review 模型

rules: At G0 write the resolved ids into .pipeline.json.models — the state file, not this template, is what a later session reads.
If review resolves to the same model as code, set review_degraded: true and say so; never claim a cross-model review you did not run.
If the host cannot bind a model per stage, the design->code->review handoffs stay manual session switches; that is a host limitation, not a pipeline failure.
